history.summary: THIS IS A SIKH GURDWARA, NOT A HINDU TEMPLE - keep-or-drop decision needed. Gurudwara Harisar Sahib stands at Pachnangal (village also rendered Mannanhana/Manhana), on Adampur Road, Kotfathui, Hoshiarpur district 144519. UNVERIFIED IDENTITY AND HISTORY: no documented Guru-visit history or founding record was found in any web source. A YouTube drone-video description calls it 'the tallest one in India' and 'very famous for annual wrestling festivals' - both claims are unverified and should be treated with caution. CSV town 'Hoshiarpur' is the district only; the actual location is the Pachnangal/Kot Fatuhi area, roughly southeast of Hoshiarpur city.

name: Gurudwara Harisar Sahib
town_description: Pachnangal, also rendered Mannanhana or Manhana, is a village near Kot Fatuhi in Hoshiarpur district, Punjab, on the Adampur Road - a rural belt of Doaba known for its gurdwaras and agricultural villages. The area lies roughly 15-20 km southeast of Hoshiarpur city (verify).

travel.airport: Adampur domestic airport (~25 km - verify); Sri Guru Ram Das Ji International Airport, Amritsar (~85 km - verify).
travel.road: On Adampur Road near Kot Fatuhi, Hoshiarpur district; reached by road from Hoshiarpur via the Hoshiarpur-Adampur route (verify).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather; check locally for the timing of the annual wrestling fair (unverified).
visitor_information.opening_hours: Listed as 4:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily on Justdial (verify). Free entry; cover head and remove shoes before entry.
